text:
Zoe (Support): Hey team — customer AcmeRetail (dedicated) filed a ticket: their A/B rollout dashboard shows variant 'green' at 92% and 'blue' at 8% but their server logs show ~50/50. They noticed it right after the console/analytics deploy yesterday. Screenshot link: https://acme.example/screenshot.png

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Can you paste the rollout_id and a sample event id + the SQL you ran to get those numbers?

Zoe (Support): rollout_id: r-2026-03-15-0048. sample event: evt_9c3f7a. SQL we ran:```SELECT variant, count(*) FROM rollout_assignments WHERE rollout_id='r-2026-03-15-0048' AND ts >= '2026-03-15' GROUP BY variant;``` Result returned: green 92000, blue 8000.

Matt (Product): I'm also seeing weird numbers in staging dashboards, likely related to yesterday's analytics schema change.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Looking. Quick question: did any service change how we emit assignment keys? We recently switched to emitting variant_index instead of variant_label in some lightweight SDKs.

Keisha (Eng-Platform): Deploy history shows analytics-service v3.4.2 rolled at 2026-03-15T18:12Z. The commit had an events proto change that removed variant_label (says the changelog).

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Run this against raw_events please:```SELECT event_id, payload->>'variant_label' as label, payload->>'variant_index' as idx FROM raw_events WHERE rollout_id='r-2026-03-15-0048' LIMIT 100;```

Zoe (Support): Ran it — label is NULL for ~90% of events, idx is present for those.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): That explains it. Our ETL aggregation still groups by variant_label. When label is NULL the grouping logic falls back to coalescing to the first enum value, which is 'green' for this experiment, so nearly all events collapse into that bucket.

Zoe (Support): So dashboard looked like a swap because missing labels got mapped to the first label value. Got it.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Root cause summary: the schema removal of variant_label in the emitted events + ETL grouping by label caused missing labels to be attributed to the wrong bucket.

Matt (Product): Customer impact P1. They want ETA for corrected numbers and whether this affected billing.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Mitigation options: 1) rollback analytics-service to re-emit label, or 2) patch ETL to use variant_index -> map to label using experiment config when label is null. I'll push a hotfix to ETL to prefer label but fall back to index mapping. Also start a backfill to recompute counts since 2026-03-15.

Keisha (Eng-Platform): I'll prepare a rollback window if needed. Staging rollback went fine.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Hotfix branch created. Backfill command:```python recompute_counts.py --rollout r-2026-03-15-0048 --from '2026-03-15' --use-index-fallback```

deploy-bot: build #3421 succeeded and deployed analytics-etl-hotfix to prod at 2026-03-16T02:04Z

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Backfill queued against raw_events for the last 48h. Estimated finish ~45m. After completion I'll trigger dashboard refresh.

Zoe (Support): Messaging the customer now: "We've identified a bug in our analytics pipeline and are backfilling corrected counts. Expect corrected dashboard in ~1hr. We'll follow up with a summary and a credit for the noise." :thumbsup:

Matt (Product): Keep ticket updated. Also check whether any billing pipelines used the wrong aggregated counts.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Billing uses a separate aggregation that uses variant_index, so billing numbers are unaffected. Only the dashboard aggregation relied on label.

MonitoringBot: Backfill job etl-backfill-558 started at 2026-03-16T02:07Z, estimated 45m.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Post-backfill check: recomputed assignment counts now match the customer's server logs within 0.5%.

Zoe (Support): Customer confirmed: "numbers look good now, thanks." Offering 5% credit for the disruption.

Keisha (Eng-Platform): Added incident to tracker INC-2026-045 and scheduled a postmortem.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Long-term fixes: 1) ETL now reads both variant_label and variant_index, maps index->label via experiment config when label missing, 2) added schema validation step to CI to fail deploys that remove required fields without an ETL migration plan, 3) added end-to-end test for label preservation.

Matt (Product): Please add a short note to release notes and console changelog: "Fixed A/B dashboard variant mapping bug for events emitted without variant_label."

Zoe (Support): Closing loop with customer and applied 5% credit to their March invoice.

Diego (Eng-Analytics): Follow-up: postmortem draft in #incidents, assigning owners for follow-up actions.

Zoe (Support): Thanks everyone, closing the support ticket now. :white_check_mark:
